prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Silicon (규소) itself — the sovereign of the Silicon Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags.
Face — her own: a stoic, unreadable reserve; light warm-beige skin with a golden undertone; oval face; medium-sized eyes — wide almond eyes, level outer eye corners; thick straight brows; straight narrow nose; thin long lips; steel-blue eyes; a bare, makeup-free face.
Body and hair: toned athletic-curvy, full-busted with rounded hips build; long hair worn half-up, half-down with center-parted bangs framing the face; blue-grey hair with a rainbow silicon-wafer sheen.
Expression: attentive, steady eyes, mouth closed.
Her element, carried in her design: silicon: beach sand and desert quartz, molten glass glowing orange in the furnace, blue-grey metallic crystal with a rainbow silicon-wafer sheen, gold circuit traces etched into chips; the most patient element of the earth's crust, stone that learned to think.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — FANTASY
Costume: a high-fantasy royal or warrior costume — plate pauldrons or a gorget, mail or scale over a long tabard or robe, a circlet or crown, a flowing cape; metal ornament and regalia built from the traits above, subtle magical glow along the patterns.
Silhouette: full plate armor from neck to feet with big rounded pauldrons and a short heraldic tabard — a solid knight's silhouette. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette. This silhouette overrides the overall shape of the costume above.
Colours: wafer blue-grey with a rainbow sheen, clear quartz, desert sand, molten-glass orange, circuit gold.
Exposure (bold): her regalia opens to show skin — bare shoulders and arms between pauldron and bracer, a deep open neckline under the gorget with natural cleavage, a high slit in the tabard or robe showing the thigh; armor pieces stay on and symmetrical. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; no corset; keep the costume above, material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: a desert of singing sands: a glassblowers' city of furnaces and coloured glass domes, towers of lightning-fused glass rising from the dunes, a cave of giant clear quartz crystals.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: natural daylight or the world's own magical glow.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Si) and atomic number (14) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish, corset, bustle, Victorian tailoring, modern material, machinery.
